features.visitor_job: Recognize Mme CLAi-O's reading room, understand the playful random-reflection promise and know its safety limits before drawing.
features.environment_object: The storefront, velvet séance room, crystal ball, fanned cards and deck on the table.
features.result: A ten-second understanding that the deck gives one random authored reflection, not prediction, diagnosis, tailored advice or current facts
features.desktop: The séance room and permanent safety panel establish place and consequence before the draw control.
features.mobile: The room crops around the table/deck while the complete boundary remains readable outside the image.
features.accessibility: Place, promise and limits are text, not art-dependent; the permanent safety panel is labelled and available before and after every draw.
features.growth_behavior: Arrival and boundary remain stable while governed deck records can change only under owner review; no current claim is baked into the room art.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new reading type or service requires its own obvious physical station, boundary, result and owner contract; it cannot become a generic section below the room.
features.preview_contract: Before activation, the visitor knows the result is random and authored, cannot answer a typed question, costs nothing and must not guide high-stakes decisions.
features.opened_experience: The ritual stays in the room and reveals a complete text result even if art, audio, analytics, storage or network access fails.

features.visitor_job: Activate the physical deck once with an obvious control and receive one non-repeating valid draw.
features.environment_object: The stacked deck on the séance table with a redundant labelled Cut the deck button.
features.result: One guarded random index from the governed 100-card deck followed by #fortuneCard focus
features.desktop: The table deck and labelled button trigger the same draw transaction; the object is not a decorative or hidden hotspot.
features.mobile: The labelled button remains a large native target even when the table image crop changes.
features.accessibility: Native keyboard/touch activation, visible focus, polite pending state, guarded repeat and zero reveal delay under reduced motion are preserved.
features.growth_behavior: The random selector accepts the governed deck length and excludes the last canonical card; changing the deck requires exact content and art mapping review.
features.new_feature_behavior: Alternate spreads, questions or personalized readings require a new bounded ritual and cannot silently alter this one-draw transaction.
features.preview_contract: The room says Cut the deck and explains the random one-card result before either control is activated.
features.opened_experience: A short optional turn resolves directly to a focused readable card; repeated clicks cannot duplicate the draw, count or keepsake event.

features.visitor_job: Read the drawn card's name, Sign, Message and small suggested Move and decide whether to keep, adapt or ignore it.
features.environment_object: A drawn card revealed in place on Mme CLAi-O's table.
features.result: One complete governed authored reflection visibly rendered and announced
features.desktop: Card art and complete reading copy appear together inside the room ritual rather than navigating to a generic result page.
features.mobile: The result becomes one readable vertical card with complete text and no simulated page turns.
features.accessibility: The region receives programmatic focus, live status announces completion and complete text remains authoritative when all art fails.
features.growth_behavior: Each governed card reuses the same four-part result shell; art filenames derive from canonical names and fail safely.
features.new_feature_behavior: A richer result type needs an explicit schema and readable fallback before admission; it cannot hide required meaning in animation or imagery.
features.preview_contract: The pre-draw boundary states exactly that the result contains one authored reflection and optional move, not foresight or tailored analysis.
features.opened_experience: The card behaves like a readable object with the whole result at once—no click-through page-flip theatre—and supports immediate stop or another draw.

features.visitor_job: Review recent canonical readings and understand the exact same-browser continuity limit.
features.environment_object: Mme CLAi-O's local reading keepsake tray beside the séance ritual.
features.result: Up to the latest three displayed readings from a validated ten-record device-local maximum plus count progress
features.desktop: History remains secondary to the current table reading and uses governed card names/text rather than trusting stored copy.
features.mobile: The local-scope heading and clear action stay in normal flow; up to three recent reading objects use a bounded horizontal strip so additional history does not lengthen the page or compress the cards.
features.accessibility: Visible text says this is not account history; malformed, unknown, oversized and future values are sanitized before rendering.
features.growth_behavior: The bounded last-ten store prevents unbounded page growth while the latest three reuse the same history object shell.
features.new_feature_behavior: Search, archive or account history is not needed at current volume and requires an authorised retention/privacy/sync contract before introduction.
features.preview_contract: Before storage-dependent continuity is used, the page states that recent readings and count stay only in this browser on this device.
features.opened_experience: Returning visitors see canonical recent readings in place and can draw again or clear them without an account or separate history page.

features.visitor_job: Understand progress toward and, after five persisted readings, receive a clearly device-local playful keepsake.
features.environment_object: The Hotline Regular progress strip and local reveal beside recent readings.
features.result: One validated local hotline-regular member or a truthful withheld result when storage fails
features.desktop: Progress and reveal remain part of the room's keepsake area and never obstruct the reading.
features.mobile: The progress/reveal text remains readable and explicitly says it is not an account reward or member benefit.
features.accessibility: The local result is textual, stable-ID deduped and only announced after successful write/read; no access or identity changes.
features.growth_behavior: The single threshold and stable ID prevent duplicate growth; unrelated valid local badge siblings are preserved.
features.new_feature_behavior: Any durable, account-backed, cross-device or Closet reward needs explicit grant, display, dedupe, remove, revoke, delete and privacy authority before copy or UI changes.
features.preview_contract: Progress copy says five completed readings on this browser unlock a local keepsake only; it does not promise currency, access or ownership.
features.opened_experience: The reveal occurs in place after a valid persisted draw and remains optional delight rather than a gate, pressure loop or fake membership transaction.

features.visitor_job: Remove Mme CLAi-O's local history, count and keepsake without deleting unrelated valid local data.
features.environment_object: A labelled clear slip beside the recent-reading keepsake tray.
features.result: Mme count/history/hotline-regular removal, fresh room state and focus returned to #claioFortuneButton
features.desktop: The clear action is attached to the history it affects, not hidden in global settings.
features.mobile: It remains a named native button alongside the exact local scope statement.
features.accessibility: The result is announced, draw focus is restored and success cannot be claimed when browser removal fails.
features.growth_behavior: Scoped deletion remains stable as local history is bounded; new local members require allow-listed ownership and deletion rules.
features.new_feature_behavior: If any Mme state becomes account-backed, this control must gain proved server deletion/revoke behavior before the local-only label changes.
features.preview_contract: The button says Clear Mme CLAi-O data beside wording that defines exactly which browser/device records exist.
features.opened_experience: Activation resets the room locally, preserves unrelated valid badge siblings and avoids a confirmation maze for low-risk reversible device data.

features.visitor_job: Return to the correct town surface, optionally play Mme CLAi-O's KSVL song or visit the Resident Card without inferred transfer.
features.environment_object: The room's Back link, labelled KSVL song control and separate Resident Card handoff note.
features.result: Correct return navigation, user-initiated audio play/pause or Resident Card route navigation only
features.desktop: Secondary controls remain outside the primary deck ritual and do not compete with the draw.
features.mobile: Each is a conventional named link/button with no precision hotspot or autoplay.
features.accessibility: Audio is optional and user initiated; the Card link makes no claim that local history or keepsake was delivered, synced or owned.
features.growth_behavior: Return context and optional media can change independently while the room result remains complete without them.
features.new_feature_behavior: Any new cross-building handoff requires a receiving-owner purpose, availability and return contract; navigation alone cannot inherit completion.
features.preview_contract: Labels state Back, KSVL play/pause and Visit your Resident Card, while adjacent copy says Mme state remains local.
features.opened_experience: Audio changes in place or a normal link enters the receiving route; none writes reading state or fabricates a handoff receipt.

current_blockers: The incumbent reading room is the correct KEEP + INTEGRATE source, but exact current desktop/mobile crop, owner visual admission and independent human review remain open; four named reading-card candidates are explicitly rejected.
The 100-card deck is a bounded hard-coded source and no compliant physical expansion station exists for a materially new reading type or service.

Hotline Regular is device-local and shared reward projection now excludes every device-local member before account-event construction; provider/public journey verification remains open but no account reward is claimed.
Mme-specific privacy-safe analytics and a Resident Card receiving receipt are absent; navigation cannot claim keepsake delivery or sync.
Native Safari, VoiceOver, 200 percent zoom, exact-candidate human comprehension, release provenance, Control Room lock and public-origin verification remain open.
